title: Accounts Administrator - Sales Ledger Clerk
description:
Accounts Administrator - Sales Ledger Clerk Nelson - Burnley £28,000-£35,000 DOE + Benefits Full-Time Office Based Working Nationwide Organisation / Excellent Opportunity

NC Associates are currently recruiting for a Accounts Administrator - Sales Ledger Clerk to join a successful and growing business based in Nelson Burnley.

This is a great opportunity for an experienced Accounts Administrator - Sales Ledger professional to join a supportive finance team, take ownership of customer accounts and play a key role in keeping the sales ledger running smoothly.

Reporting directly to the Finance Manager, you'll be responsible for customer invoicing, cash allocation, account reconciliations and credit control support, ensuring records are accurate, payments are allocated correctly and customer queries are dealt with efficiently. As well as Sales Ledger duties you will also gain experience across various aspects of transactional finance and month end.

Benefits
- Salary of £28,000-£35,000, depending on experience
- Free parking
- AAT study support after successful probation
- Competitive company benefits
- Permanent position
- Career development and training opportunities
- Supportive finance team

Role Overview

As an Accounts Administrator - Sales Ledger Clerk, you'll take responsibility for key sales ledger activities, from raising customer invoices and allocating receipts through to investigating discrepancies and supporting the collection of outstanding debt.

You'll work closely with the Finance Manager and colleagues across the business, helping maintain accurate customer accounts, meet financial deadlines and ensure all transactions are processed in line with company procedures. This is a great opportunity to build on your experience and learn new skills across finance.

Key Responsibilities
- Raising and issuing customer invoices accurately and within agreed time-scales
- Allocating customer receipts and ensuring accounts are kept up to date
- Supporting credit control activities, including chasing outstanding payments
- Investigating and resolving customer account and invoice queries
- Reconciling customer accounts and identifying discrepancies
- Monitoring outstanding balances and highlighting any issues
- Maintaining accurate sales ledger records within the finance system
- Supporting cash allocation and bank reconciliation processes where required
- Assisting with month-end procedures and financial reporting
- Ensuring all transactions comply with company procedures and financial controls
- Working with internal departments to resolve queries and maintain positive customer relationships
- Identifying opportunities to improve sales ledger processes and reporting

Essential Experience Required
- Previous experience in a sales ledger, accounts receivable or transactional finance
- Good understanding of customer accounts, cash allocation and reconciliation's
- Experience dealing with customer queries and supporting credit control
- Strong numerical accuracy and attention to detail
- Confident using Microsoft Excel and accounting systems
- Excellent communication and organisational skills
- Ability to manage a busy workload and meet deadlines
- A proactive approach to problem-solving and maintaining accurate financial records

Desirable:
- AAT Level 2, 3 or 4, or currently studying towards a qualification
- Can do attitude, willingness to want to learn new tasks

Why Apply?

If you're looking for your next move finance, this is an opportunity to join an established and growing business offering a competitive salary, the chance to develop your skills within a wider finance function.

Interested? Apply today for immediate consideration by sending your CV to or call

NC Associates welcomes applications from candidates with relevant sales ledger and accounts experience.

We are committed to diversity and inclusion. We welcome all applicants of identity, personal characteristics, or background.

title: Purchase Ledger
company: Hays Specialist Recruitment Limited - Agency - Permanent
description:
Your new company
I am working with a well-established specialist manufacturing business, based in Colne. Due to an upcoming departure within the finance team and pending maternity leave, an opportunity has arisen for an experienced Purchase Ledger Clerk to join the business on a 12 month initial fixed term contract. This is a varied finance role where purchase ledger will be your primary responsibility, whilst also supporting month-end accounting activities and payroll administration.

Your new role
In your new role as Purchase Ledger, you will take ownership of the purchase ledger function, processing approximately 250 invoices per month and ensuring supplier payments and reconciliations are completed accurately. Alongside your purchase ledger responsibilities, you will have exposure to wider finance duties, including journals, month-end reporting and supporting the payroll process for hourly paid employees. As the main point of contact for purchase ledger matters, you will handle invoice processing, supplier reconciliations and query resolution, whilst also supporting month-end activities, including journals and financial reporting. The role will additionally involve assisting with the payroll process for hourly paid employees and providing wider support to the finance function as required. The business operates SAP Business One, so previous ERP experience would be advantageous.

What you'll need to succeed
To be successful in this position, you will have proven purchase ledger experience gained within a busy finance environment and be confident managing a high-volume workload. You will possess strong attention to detail, excellent organisational skills and the ability to build positive relationships with internal stakeholders and suppliers. Experience of month-end processes, reconciliations and ERP systems, ideally SAP Business One, would be beneficial, although a proactive attitude and willingness to learn are equally important.

What you'll get in return
In return, you will join a friendly and established finance team within a successful manufacturing business that can offer stability, variety and the opportunity to broaden your finance experience beyond a traditional purchase ledger position.
